name: io.github.Fredobumma/shutterstock-mcp
title: Shutterstock
description: Search Shutterstock photos, footage, music and news images; preview, collect and license them.

environmentVariables.name: SHUTTERSTOCK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Shutterstock app's consumer key, for searching

environmentVariables.name: SHUTTERSTOCK_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.name: SHUTTERSTOCK_ENABLE_LICENSING
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to add the license_asset tool, which spends your subscription
